title: Localize PesterIntervalStepper's label and minutes text
description: Replace the hardcoded 'Every' label and the always-plural '$minutes minutes' text (a latent grammar bug for 1 minute) with resource-backed lookups, using a real <plurals> for the minutes text.
acceptance_criteria: The minutes text comes from pluralStringResource(R.plurals.minutes_count, minutes, minutes), correctly showing '1 minute' (singular) instead of the old always-plural '1 minutes'
The '-'/'+' step button glyphs are left as-is (not language-dependent, no resource needed)
No other logic in the function is changed
name: PesterIntervalStepper
